gameover.why: the defeat cadence: G minor braam, a cluster hit, Eb (bVI) -> D (V) -> the last G minor hit, then the fall into silence. Take 1 scored higher only on its louder-first shape; its middle is a weaker F -> Ab -> F, and take 3 is one hit with no cadence (9.8 s).

victory.why: the best score (1.000): a near-silent D drone for 4.5 s under his death line, then Bm -> G -> A -> D (vi-IV-V-I) with a climbing arpeggio, landing on D major at 14 s and ringing out.
